ai.title: Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework
ai.brief: Google Cloud AI Research has open-sourced Harness² . It is a recursive agent harnessing framework that improves the code and files around a frozen model. For developers, the pitch is simple. Your agent may get better without a better model. TL;DR Size: A framework, not a model. 0 parameters trained; 8 editable harness components. 0 . 13 and uv. Model runs call models through Vertex AI. GPU requirement: Not disclosed. Performance: 1 refinement step improved all 4 model and harness setups on all 3 benchmarks. 5 points). 8). What is Harness²? Harness² is a plug-and-play framework from Google Research that refines an agent’s harness during deployment. A harness is everything around the model: prompts, tools, memory, skills and orchestration . Harnessing is the process of optimizing that system. Model weights never change. The target setting is the open world.

sec.title: Rust-Based CikaBika Bot Turns Discord into a Command Center
sec.brief: S. S. S. S. CISA adds Microsoft Windows Shell flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Darktrace researchers have documented a new campaign distributing a remote access trojan called CikaBika Bot, written in Rust and controlled entirely through Discord. The infection chain starts with a disk image that looks like a business proposal, and ends with an attacker who can run arbitrary commands, steal files, and capture your screen, all through messages in a chat platform. “The infection chain begins with a disk image and a malicious Windows shortcut. ” reads the analysis published by Darktrace. ”
